text: [tired, quiet] Forty years I've come here. [sighs] I've never seen them give up like that.
Boos at Old Trafford again. One question. Is it Carrick... or the players?
[angry, fast] It's him! He's had long enough. We look lost out there, every single week.
[passionate, raised voice] It's the players, mate! He's the one fella who actually cares. They downed tools on him.
[laughing in disbelief] I flew from Lagos for the Bournemouth game. Lagos! [laughs] Three nil. I'm still recovering.
[calm, firm] Neither. Look upstairs. How many managers since Fergie? Same mess every time.
Carrick, or the players? You tell us.
